trigger.description: An opt-in warm daemon search or pack retrieval cannot negotiate the exact envelope, method, authorization, and method-specific schemas, its round-trip fails, its scope requires local hydration, its pack handoff cannot prove matching source generation, complete feedback contents or calibration state, or the bounded capability-plus-retrieval attempt expires (five seconds by default). Nonempty feedback is supported when the v2 witness matches; legacy v1 handoffs and changed or unavailable witnesses fall back locally. The CLI executes canonical in-process search and records why the requested acceleration path was not used.
